Priyanka Kakkar Leaves AAP for Congress, Citing Indefensible Actions

Priyanka Kakkar has resigned from the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and joined the Congress party. She stated her reason for leaving was that she could no longer defend "the indefensible" actions within the AAP. Her departure is described as a political jolt to the AAP, and she has urged for opposition unity.
